title: Everything your business needs to stay compliant
intro: From tax and audit to business advisory and risk management, we cover the full spectrum of corporate, financial and regulatory services — with people who actually pick up the phone.

items.title: Tax Planning & Compliance
items.description: Corporate & individual tax — planning, returns, rebates and registrations done right and on time.
points: FBR / SRB / PRA / KPRA registration & compliance

items.title: Audit & Assurance Services
items.description: Independent audits, risk reviews and financial reporting that satisfy regulators and surface real operational insight.

items.title: Business Growth & Transformation Consulting
items.description: Set up, structure and scale your business the right way — from incorporation to outsourced CFO support.
points: Pvt / Public Ltd, partnership (AOP) & trust registration

items.title: Strategic Business Advisory
items.description: Stay in good standing with SECP and every regulator while we handle the corporate and strategic groundwork.
points: Annual return filing with SECP & alteration in Articles/MOA

items.title: Risk Management & Insurance Solutions
items.description: Protect what you've built — risk consulting, Takaful/insurance advisory and employee-welfare compliance.
